title: Judgment on the Rebels and Blessing for the Lord's Servants
description: The Lord accuses a rebellious people who sacrifice to other gods and offend Him, warning of judgment upon them. At the same time, He promises to preserve a remnant of Jacob and Judah, His servants who seek Him. He will create new heavens and a new earth, making Jerusalem a city filled with joy and peace where the wolf and the lamb graze together.
